author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you’ve ever wanted to experience China beyond the guidebooks, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

We’re heading deep into the mountains, right on the edge of China and Myanmar.
This remote region was once at the center of one of the most dangerous air missions of the Second World War: The Hump.
With the Burma Road cut off, Allied pilots had to fly over some of the world’s most treacherous mountains, carrying vital supplies from India into Yunnan.
Today, we’re following their route and venturing into one of the most remote corners of China.
